research_rejections.title: The Gorge
research_rejections.reason: Public reviews describe an extended initial watchtower courtship and character setup before the monster-combat and escape sequences. The action is concentrated later in the 127-minute runtime, so sustained whole-film action density cannot be established.

research_rejections.title: CHiPs
research_rejections.reason: Motorcycle chases occur, but reviews emphasize recurring crude buddy comedy and character banter; the evidence does not substantiate sufficiently high action density throughout its 101-minute runtime.

research_rejections.title: Paycheck
research_rejections.reason: The sci-fi puzzle and chase premise is promising, but reviews identify uneven urgency and isolated motorcycle chase, combat and explosions. Insufficient whole-runtime corroboration for the profile's dominant action-density requirement.
